Warped Passages: Unraveling the Mysteries of the Universe's Hidden Dimensions is the debut non-fiction book by Lisa Randall , published in 2005, about particle physics in general and additional dimensions of space (cf. Kaluza–Klein theory ) in particular. The book has made it to top 50 at amazon.com , making it the world's first successful book on theoretical physics by a female author. She herself characterizes the book as being about physics and the multi-dimensional universe. [1] The book describes, at a non-technical level,

* Hiding in the Mirror by Lawrence Krauss
